audit.why: Brand out-pokes and out-bursts Lulu pre-6; from two items her Wild Growth (R) knockup-heal and Polymorph turn her into peel that hard-counters his all-in.

edits.before: W-poke the pair — the pillar splashes bot's formation tax from level 1.
edits.after: At level 1 your W and Blaze out-poke Lulu's single Glitterlance.

edits.before: E joins: the ablaze-stun package threatens; the lane flinches at level 2.
edits.after: Your level-2 W-on-E burst beats her poke before shields matter.

edits.before: Full kit: E-Q stuns through the wave and the W bills the dodge attempt.
edits.after: At level 3 your combo damage keeps her on the defensive.

edits.before: Rotation-chip the margins — three spells on anyone is a detonation event.
edits.after: Through levels 4-5 you out-trade her weak poke every exchange.

edits.before: Pyroclasm online — grouped duos pay the bounce tax; never lane in a line.
edits.after: Your level-6 Pyroclasm on a stunned target out-threatens her peel.

edits.before: First item: the burn compounds and the stun package deletes.
edits.after: First-item Blaze burn out-chips her poke and shields.

edits.before: Late support Brand is a teamfight bill: spread the blaze, R the clump, and stun the survivors.
edits.after: At 2+ items Lulu's Wild Growth and Polymorph hard-counter your all-in.

edits.before: Blackfire Torch Blaze burn out-chips Lulu's Q poke and pressures through her Help Pix shields.
edits.after: Blackfire Torch Blaze burn out-chips Lulu's Q poke and pressures through her Help, Pix! shields.

edits.before: W the pair, E the ablaze, Q the stun, walk — the package billed two and the burn collects after.
edits.after: Land Q-stun before you cast Pyroclasm — Whimsy can Poly-cancel the ult if you open with it instead.

edits.before: Q-poking clean targets while the engage waits — the unablazed Q is the kit's most expensive miss.
edits.after: Rotating to poke the support only wastes pressure her Glitterlance and Help, Pix! can outheal alone.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Liandry's, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Liandry's, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.before: - Lulu Whimsy (Polymorph): matchup-defining — The polymorph deletes a carry’s kit mid-fight — bait it before the real engage. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E-Q stun package answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Lulu Whimsy (Polymorph): 18s flat cooldown — it deletes a carry's kit mid-fight; bait it before the real engage. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E-Q stun package answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Wild Growth (R, 120/100/80s) is for swing moments only.
